in_sanskrit.name: Shurendra
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the lord of forts, citadels, or strongholds.

in_hindi.name: शुरेंद्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who initiates battles or conflicts, a warrior god.

in_marathi.name: Surend
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Obtainer of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Surend हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who obtains victory over desires, worldly pleasures, and negative emotions. Often associated with the Hindu deity, Lord Shiva.

in_bengali.name: Surend
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Obtainer of Victory
in_bengali.long_meaning: Surend একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who obtains victory over desires, worldly pleasures, and negative emotions. Often associated with the Hindu deity, Lord Shiva.
